instruct: A weary, intellectual male voice in his 30s-40s, conveying deep sorrow, suppressed rage, and intellectual exhaustion. His speech is clipped, with pauses that feel like emotional weight. He speaks with a quiet, almost resigned bitterness, as if carrying the burden of a failed mission and personal loss. His tone is layered with regret and a faint, lingering hope — the kind that only someone who has seen the world’s decay and still believes in redemption might possess.
